in_sanskrit.name: धरम्वीर
in_sanskrit.meaning: धर्म (Dharma) - righteousness, virtue, law; वीर (Vir) - hero, brave, valiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who possesses righteousness and is brave and valiant.

in_hindi.name: धरम्वीर
in_hindi.meaning: धर्म (Dharma) - धरना (Dharana) - to hold, to support; वीर (Vir) - वीर्य (Veerya) - bravery, valor
in_hindi.long_meaning: He who holds or supports righteousness and has bravery and valor.

in_telugu.name: ధరమ్బిర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: He who is brave in upholding dharma.

in_marathi.name: Dharambir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dharma (duty) + Bir (brave, hero)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharambir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dharambir is derived from Sanskrit, where 'Dharam' means duty, righteousness, and 'Bir' means brave, hero. This name represents a courageous individual who is committed to his dharma, or duty, and upholds the moral and ethical values of society.

This name represents a courageous individual who is committed to his dharma, or duty, and upholds the moral and ethical values of society.
